title: Koszul powers detect supported objects on an affine scheme
statement: Let X=Spec(A) be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], let f_1, ..., f_r be elements of A, and let U=X minus V(f_1, ..., f_r). For each tuple e=(e_1, ..., e_r) of positive integers, let K_e be the bounded Koszul complex on f_1^{e_1}, ..., f_r^{e_r}, regarded as a perfect object of D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-perfect-complex]. If E is in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X) and E restricted to U is zero, then E=0 whenever Hom(K_e[n],E)=0 for every tuple e and every integer n.

source.place: Tag 09IR, proof using Lemma 36.9.6 and Lemma 36.3.5
